description: NFVIs is polymorphic on nfviType (AzureCore, AzureArcKubernetes, AzureOperatorNexus); the converted model keeps only the base members, so S.Struct strips the subtype payload. Add `location` (AzureCore) and `customLocationReference` (Arc/Nexus).

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Location of the Azure core NFVI (`AzureCore` only).
Reference `{ id }` to the custom location (`AzureArcKubernetes` / `AzureOperatorNexus`).
